claim: The XMapEdit observer truncates negative coordinates, so frames of a map translated by a fraction of 1,024 do not match; it also cannot draw a mirror (504 on a one-sided wall), which only the game shows.
evidence: Gravesend's release translation and underpass mirror, 2026-11-25.
use: Snap poses to 1/1024 before comparing frames; judge mirrors in play.
